title: Cheesy Bean and Sprout Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful vegetarian pilaf dish loaded with cheese, beans, and sprouts. Perfect for a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: bean
ingredients.notes: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat butter or margarine in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add pilaf and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add black beans, alfalfa sprouts, and shredded cheese. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the sprouts are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
